parkGuideMap.title: Find rides on the guide map
parkGuideMap.help: Numbers match the official guide; they are not wait times. Overlapping markers are reduced in the overview. Zoom or search to find every facility, then select a marker or list item for details.
parkGuideMap.guide: Extracted from the official September 2026 guide. Illustrated locations, not exact entrances or walking directions.
parkGuideMap.lotStatus: Lotte World currently provides operating status through our source. Numeric waiting times are unavailable and are not shown.
parkGuideMap.noStatus: Gyeongju World live operation and waiting times are not connected. A marker does not indicate that a ride is currently operating.
parkGuideMap.stale: Operating data is over 20 minutes old. Check official information for current status.
parkGuideMap.notCollected: Operating status has not yet been collected.
parkGuideMap.unmatched: Facilities from the current source that could not be matched to this guide are not placed at guessed locations.
